notes.title: Five Nights at Roner's 2 - Revamp update coming soon!
notes.notes:
As many of you are surely aware, Five Nights at Roner's 2 is quite a bit buggy. Although past updates attempted to fix the issues present, the game still just isn't as good as it could be. In addition, the files for this game have been lost for a long time now, so I've been unable to update the game.

With that being said, since this silly little series has picked up in popularity a bit since FNaR: Remastered's release, I have decided to finally attempt to fix the issues in this game!

I should note that this will be a difficult task. Since the files are gone, all I can do is rip assets from the EXE file, and re-code the game from the ground up. This will take time! But in the end, I believe it will be worth it.

In addition, I'd like to mention that the Nightclub DLC has not been forgotten! It's simply been put on the back-burner while I've been working hard on FNaR 3. This DLC will be a short story/content expansion, focusing heavily on Duane's backstory. Not much is revealed about him in FNaR 2, but since he will be an important character in FNaR 3, I think this DLC will serve as a good little sneak peak into what you might be able to expect from the game!

notes.title: IMPORTANT NOTICE: FNAR 2 WILL SOON BECOME F2P
notes.notes: I am working with customer support at Valve at the moment to change FNAR 2 to a free game. I felt a bit weird about charging for a fan game, even if it took half a year of development. If you already own the game, don't worry! This will not affect you. :D

notes.title: Wishlist Five Nights at Roner's: Remastered now!
notes.notes:
I had a bit of trouble with Steam reviewing my game build and store page, which unfortunately means the release date had to be pushed back to November 21st. Regardless, the game is now available to wishlist on steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3294890/Five_Nights_at_Roners_Remastered/

The game will be completely free to play!

FNaR Remastered has come a long way since the initial announcement, and I honestly think it surpasses FNaR 2 in terms of quality (But that's up to you to decide!)

notes.notes:

I saw many people complaining of the game being too hard, so this should help people enjoy the game regardless of their skill issue :P
